notes.title: New Update July 26, 2024
notes.content:
- Boring sections have been smoothed out to make the game more fluid.
- The game freezing issue after the bus sound that came when the game was opening has been resolved.
- The cargo has been delivered to closer addresses.
- The problem of cargo stuck behind the counter has been resolved. Stuck cargo can now be picked up.
- The number of cargo deliveries in the first mission has been reduced.
